nodes.label: OpenAPI Must Stay in Sync (Rule)
nodes.rationale: Any API change must update openapi/openapi.yaml. API behavior should be independently testable.

nodes.label: GitHub as Source of Truth (Architecture Doc)
nodes.norm_label: github as source of truth (architecture doc)

nodes.label: ADR-001: GitHub Is the Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: github is the source of truth
nodes.rationale: User vault should remain portable and user-owned. Application is an interface/API layer, not the owner of notes. Supabase-as-canonical and app-owned storage were rejected to preserve portability and user ownership.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Supabase Responsibilities
nodes.rationale: Project needed auth, metadata, and backend API without a dedicated server, remaining within zero-cost development. Traditional backend server rejected for complexity. Supabase-as-canonical-storage rejected because GitHub is source of truth.

nodes.label: ADR-003: API Boundary
nodes.rationale: Direct client-to-GitHub would expose credentials and create security concerns. Separate API per client would duplicate backend logic. Versioned common API (/v1/) via Supabase Edge Functions keeps credentials server-side and clients consistent.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Markdown Vault Format
nodes.rationale: Proprietary formats reduce portability and user ownership. Markdown is human-readable, Git-compatible, and tooling-agnostic. YAML frontmatter allowed for metadata. Supabase-managed note records rejected.

nodes.label: ADR-005: PWA and Swift Share the Same API
nodes.norm_label: adr-005: pwa and swift share the same api
nodes.rationale: Separate backends would duplicate business logic and create behavioral inconsistencies. Swift directly accessing GitHub would bypass backend security. Shared OpenAPI contract ensures consistent vault access for both clients.

nodes.label: Clients Must Not Perform Privileged GitHub Operations (Rule)
nodes.norm_label: clients must not perform privileged github operations (rule)
nodes.rationale: PWA and Swift apps must route GitHub operations through Supabase API/Edge Function to prevent credential exposure.

nodes.label: GitHub Is the Source of Truth (Rule)
nodes.norm_label: github is the source of truth (rule)
nodes.rationale: User vault contents must remain canonical in the user's private GitHub repository to preserve portability, user ownership, and Git-based version history. Supabase and local caches are derived state.

nodes.label: Markdown Is the Canonical Note Format (Rule)
nodes.norm_label: markdown is the canonical note format (rule)
nodes.rationale: Notes must remain ordinary Markdown files so users can access their data outside the application. Frontmatter is acceptable but Markdown remains canonical.

nodes.label: PWA and Swift Must Use the Same API (Rule)
nodes.norm_label: pwa and swift must use the same api (rule)
nodes.rationale: The PWA and future Swift/iOS application must consume the same backend API contract (OpenAPI). No separate backend for iOS.

nodes.label: Supabase Is Not Canonical Note Storage (Rule)
nodes.norm_label: supabase is not canonical note storage (rule)
nodes.rationale: Supabase handles authentication, session management, vault metadata, and Edge Functions but must never store canonical Markdown note contents. Any change requires an ADR and project-owner approval.

nodes.label: Keep the MVP Simple (Rule)
nodes.rationale: Do not prematurely implement GraphRAG, vector DBs, embeddings, semantic search, knowledge graphs, conflict-resolution engines, or AI features. First objective is a reliable Git-backed Markdown vault.
